review_notes: Same transport operator acting for Nantes Metropole. Anchor is diagnostic survey of tramway cable ducts and cable identification (CPV 45232332); candidate is onboard equipment and software for bus traffic-light priority and insertion/extraction (CPV 34996000). Different systems and different works/supply nature.

Same municipality; both are insurance service contracts covering the same five risk lots (property, fleet, civil liability, legal protection, statutory staff risks); CPV sets overlap almost entirely; 1425-day gap matches the standard four-year insurance cycle.

Same hospital and same software-maintenance domain, but the evidence is one title line. Candidate reproduces the anchor title verbatim and adds a line on RIS (QDoc/QPlanner) maintenance, so it is impossible to tell whether this is a later re-letting of the IWS maintenance or a further publication of the same procedure with an adjacent object attached. 550-day gap fits either reading.

Same department. Anchor procures a grants-management software solution; candidate procures a Skype SBC subscription with maintenance. Different systems, different CPVs (72262000 vs 72268000), no shared operational need.

Same community of communes. Anchor procures a private inter-site dark fibre network; candidate procures a survey and treatment of underground cavities on the authority's land. No shared need; CPV 45200000 vs 45120000.

Same community of communes (prefix variant only). Anchor is outsourced management of the authority's information system; candidate is delivery of a housing improvement programme (PIG France Renov and OPAH-RU follow-up). Different needs, CPV 72514000 vs 71241000.

Same department. Anchor acquires a booking, ticketing and access-control solution for museums and heritage sites; candidate commissions soil pollution studies. No shared need, CPV 48900000 vs 71351500.
